title: Basic demographics (Open Survey Platform)
description: A plain starter set written for this project: age in years, country, first language, handedness and vision correction. Adapt freely; harmonised national standards (for example the UK ONS / GSS harmonised standards) are better where comparability matters.

licence.statement: Written for Open Survey Platform and dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal.

citation.text: Open Survey Platform contributors (2026). Basic demographics question set. CC0 1.0.

source.note: Our own wording; no third-party text.

scoring.text: No scores. Age is a whole number of years (0–120).
